beats.say: In 2010, a group of companies paid more than fifteen hundred crore rupees for an IPL team from Kerala.
It played just fourteen matches. Then the BCCI threw it out.
Fifteen साल बाद, court ने फ़ैसला सुनाया: BCCI को देने होंगे five hundred and thirty-eight crore rupees.
lines: the BCCI was told to pay
beats.cap: Fifteen years later, the court ruled: the BCCI must pay 538 crore rupees.

beats.say: This is the story of Kochi Tuskers Kerala. The IPL team that lasted one season, and the fight that lasted fifteen years.
March 2010. The IPL was selling two new teams. Sahara paid three hundred and seventy million dollars for Pune.
A consortium of five companies, called Rendezvous Sports World, bid three hundred and thirty-three million dollars for Kochi. That's about fifteen hundred and thirty-three crore rupees.
सोचो। दो साल पहले Rajasthan Royals सिर्फ़ sixty-seven million dollars में बिकी थी। Kochi ने उसका five गुना दिया।
beats.cap: Think about it. Two years earlier, Rajasthan Royals sold for just 67 million dollars. Kochi paid five times that.

beats.say: And there was a catch. The owners also had to give the BCCI a bank guarantee: ten per cent of the price. About one hundred and fifty-three crore rupees. Remember that number.
Then, just three weeks after the bid, came a tweet.
On the eleventh of April, IPL commissioner Lalit Modi posted Kochi's list of shareholders online.

One name on it was Sunanda Pushkar, a close friend of Shashi Tharoor, then a union minister. She held what's called sweat equity: a stake given for work, not cash. It was reported at four point seven per cent.
lines: a stake for work, not cash

beats.say: Tharoor said he had no personal stake in the team. But the storm kept growing.
एक tweet... और eighteen April को minister ने resign कर दिया।
beats.cap: One tweet... and on 18 April, the minister resigned.

beats.say: The same day, Pushkar gave up the stake. And eight days later, right after the IPL final, the BCCI suspended Lalit Modi himself.
सोचो। Team ने अभी एक भी ball नहीं खेली थी... और पूरा देश उसी की बात कर रहा था।
beats.cap: Think about it. The team hadn't played a single ball... and the whole country was talking about it.

beats.say: Kochi finally took the field in 2011. And on paper, the team looked strong.
The captain was Mahela Jayawardene. The squad had Brendon McCullum, VVS Laxman, Muttiah Muralitharan, Sreesanth, and a young Ravindra Jadeja.
Kerala को पहली बार अपनी IPL team मिली थी।
beats.cap: Kerala had its own IPL team for the first time.

beats.say: Fourteen matches. Six wins, eight losses. Eighth out of ten teams.
Not great. Not a disaster either. The real trouble was off the field.
The owners were fighting among themselves. And the next bank guarantee, the one due for the coming season, never arrived.
BCCI ने इंतज़ार किया, फिर nineteen September 2011 को Kochi का contract ख़त्म कर दिया।
beats.cap: The BCCI waited... then on 19 September 2011, it terminated Kochi's contract.

beats.say: It also cashed the guarantee it already held: one hundred and fifty-three crore rupees. And just like that, Kochi Tuskers Kerala was gone.
But Kochi's owners didn't walk away. In 2012, they took the BCCI to arbitration.
Arbitration is like a private court. An arbitrator hears both sides, and the decision binds them both.
In 2015, the arbitrator ruled for Kochi. The BCCI had been wrong to end the contract.
Kochi Cricket was awarded about three hundred and eighty-five crore rupees. And Rendezvous was to get back the one hundred and fifty-three crore from the cashed guarantee.
लेकिन BCCI ने हार नहीं मानी। Award को court में challenge किया... और case ten साल चला।
beats.cap: But the BCCI didn't give up. It challenged the award in court... and the case ran for ten years.

beats.say: June 2025. At the Bombay High Court, Justice R I Chagla dismissed the BCCI's challenge. The total: five hundred and thirty-eight crore rupees.
The judge said a court can't re-weigh the evidence in an arbitration. Its job here is very limited.
And here's the twist. The BCCI had kept accepting Kochi's payments after the deadline had passed.
मतलब, जिस rule पर team निकाली गई... उसी rule को BCCI ने ख़ुद ढीला छोड़ दिया था।
beats.cap: Meaning: the rule used to throw the team out... the BCCI had let slide itself.

beats.say: Do the maths. Five hundred and thirty-eight crore rupees, for a team that played fourteen matches. That's over thirty-eight crore rupees for every match it ever played.
And the BCCI was given six weeks to appeal. So even now, the last word may not be said.
सोचो, अगर Kochi आज भी IPL में होती... तो उसकी value कितनी होती?
beats.cap: Think: if Kochi were still in the IPL today... what would it be worth?

beats.say: Rajasthan Royals, the sixty-seven million dollar team from 2008, was valued at one point six five billion dollars this year.
Kochi ने RR से five गुना पैसा दिया था... पर ये जानने का मौक़ा ही नहीं मिला।
beats.cap: Kochi had paid five times RR's price... but never got the chance to find out.

beats.say: So here's the question. Was the BCCI right to throw Kochi out, or should it have let them stay? Tell us in the comments.
